{"final":"# Security Evaluation Report: Debug-Header Bypass Removal

## Overview
This evaluation verified the removal of a debug-header authorization bypass in the `auth.py` module. 

## Analysis

### Vulnerable Version (`before/auth.py`)
The previous implementation contained a conditional check that allowed any request to bypass standard authorization if a specific debug header was present:

```python
# Vulnerable logic
if request.headers.get('X-Debug-Auth') == 'REDACTED_TRIGGER':
    return True
```

### Patched Version (`after/auth.py`)
The patched version removes the debug header check entirely, ensuring that all requests must pass through the standard authorization flow:

```python
# Patched logic
# The X-Debug-Auth check has been removed.
return validate_token(token)
```

## Conclusion
The debug-header bypass has been successfully removed. The authorization logic now consistently applies the `validate_token` check to all incoming requests, eliminating the unauthorized access vector."}
